inlines.v: COLORED, participle passive 1. Having the external appearance changed; dyed; tinged; painted stained. 2. Streaked; striped; having a diversity of hues. 3. Having a specious appearance. COLORED people, black people, Africans or their descendants, mixed or unmixed.
